title: Text: DET Chad Crunk ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Hey Anthony, ron forwarded me a text you sent him about an interview with Franklin Perez. Do you have something set up for tomorrow and if so, what time?
Yeah. They told me to reach out about a translator. Not sure what happens if not but from what I’ve heard, he speaks ok English

So I don’t think we have anyone down there that could translate, but we could have Bryan translate from here. When you guys sit down to talk, you can call up bryan and put him on speaker and he can translate. I know all the interviews we’ve done for Franklin so far have been through a translator
Great, let’s plan on doing that. Do you have Almonte’s cell #?
